why: Owner never-touch lists for bin/worktree-clean. A repo key matches the main checkout's folder name or origin's repository name. A name pattern matches the branch, any '/'-separated part of it, or any folder on the worktree's path. ~/.config/nadavai/worktree-clean.json can add to these lists, never remove from them. On 2026-11-01 the tool removed 38 ~/Desktop/tf-513-* worktrees from the TherapyFlow owner's list.

therapy-flow-v2.why: TherapyFlow owner (dagon, 2026-10-28): never git worktree prune/remove on therapy-flow-v2; a live ITA process and workflows write there.

sportchat-web.why: SportChat owner (2026-10-27): lane base, merge train, deploy and owner worktrees, and every v4 lane (folder v4-*, or branch v4/*, e.g. ~/sporchat-v4-tmp/wt-ui-quick) whose HEAD has not landed in origin/main. v4-bk-0-live, v4-data-1-first20 and audit-4f962617 added 2026-11-03: in origin/main but named by the owner session during the 2026-11-03 production train; remove them from this list only on the SportChat owner's word.

nadavai-ci-slot.why: CI infrastructure (nadavai-slot.service builds branch heads in these worktrees); its worktrees are managed by the CI tooling, not by this cleaner.
